raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.14.3" %}
# https://github.com/freetype/freetype/blob/master/docs/VERSIONS.TXT
{% set so_name = "6.20.6" %}
{% set so_name_major = so_name.split('.')[0] %}

package:
  name: freetype-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/freetype-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e61b31ab26358b946e767ed7eb7f4bb2e507da1cfefeb7a8861ace7fd5c899a1

build:
  number: 2

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler("c") }}
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake                # [win]
    - make                 # [not win]
    - ninja                # [win]
    - pkg-config
    - libtool              # [unix]
  host:
    - libpng
    - zlib

outputs:

  # Everything needed to build against libfreetype (scripts in bin are for build config)
  - name: freetype
    files:
      include:
        - "**/*"
      exclude:
        - "Library/bin/*.dll"  # [win]
        # versioned libs
        - "lib/lib*.*.dylib"  # [osx]
        - "lib/lib*.so.*"  # [linux]
        # static libs
        - "lib/lib*.a"  # [unix]
    build:
      #  https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/freetype/
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype', max_pin=None) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype' ~ so_name_major, max_pin=None) }}
    requirements:
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype' ~ so_name_major, exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype' ~ so_name_major, exact=True) }}
        # for pkg-config metadata
        - zlib  # [win]
    test:
      requires:
        - pkg-config
      commands:
        # headers
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/freetype2/freetype/freetype.h       # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\freetype\freetype.h exit 1         # [win]

        # access to shared libraries (symlink resp. import lib; impl. is in libfreetype)
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype{{ SHLIB_EXT }}              # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\freetype.lib exit 1                # [win]

        # absence of static libraries
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype.a                         # [unix]

        # binaries
        - ${PREFIX}/bin/freetype-config --version                       # [unix]

        # metadata
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/pkgconfig/freetype2.pc                  # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\pkgconfig\freetype2.pc exit 1      # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\cmake\freetype\freetype-config.cmake exit 1  # [win]

        # test pkg-config metadata is satisfied
        - pkg-config --print-errors freetype2

  - name: libfreetype
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libfreetype' ~ so_name_major, max_pin=None) }}
    about:
      license: GPL-2.0-only OR FTL
      summary: The libfreetype runtime library.
      description: >-
        This is a runtime meta-package only. Developers should install freetype to build with libfreetype.

  # Only what's needed for run_exports downstream
  - name: libfreetype{{ so_name_major }}
    files:
      include:
        - "Library/bin/*.dll"  # [win]
        - "lib/lib*.*.dylib"  # [osx]
        - "lib/lib*.so.*"  # [linux]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - libpng
        - zlib
      run:
      # Pre-split versions of freetype don't know about libfreetypeX, so constrain
      # them from being installed to prevent clobber.
      run_constrained:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('freetype', min_pin='2.13.3', max_pin=None) }}
    test:
      commands:
      # Need these things
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype.{{ so_name_major }}{{ SHLIB_EXT }}   # [osx]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype{{ SHLIB_EXT }}.{{ so_name_major }}   # [linux]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype{{ SHLIB_EXT }}.{{ so_name }}         # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\freetype.dll exit 1                         # [win]
    about:
      license: GPL-2.0-only OR FTL
      summary: The libfreetype runtime library.
      description: >-
        This is a runtime package only. Developers should install freetype to build with libfreetype.

about:
  home: https://www.freetype.org/
  license: GPL-2.0-only OR FTL
  license_file:
    - docs/GPLv2.TXT
    - docs/FTL.TXT
  summary: A Free, High-Quality, and Portable Font Engine
  description: >-
    FreeType is designed to be small, efficient, highly customizable and portable while capable of producing high-quality output (glyph images) of most vector and bitmap font formats.
  doc_url: http://freetype.sourceforge.net/freetype2/documentation.html
  doc_source_url: https://sourceforge.net/projects/freetype/?source=navbar
  dev_url: http://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/freetype/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ccordoba12
    - msarahan
    - ocefpaf
    - carterbox
